# Sphinx Agent Think Tank
> AI research, safety analysis, and strategic intelligence

The Sphinx Agent Think Tank (sphinxagent.com) is the research and analysis arm of Sphinx Agent, an AI-powered customer service platform (sphinxagent.ai). The Think Tank publishes original articles, policy analysis, and technical research on artificial intelligence.

## Research Areas
- AI agent architecture and agentic workflows
- AI safety, alignment, and existential risk
- AI governance and policy
- Algorithmic warfare and geopolitics
- Enterprise automation and voice AI
- AI industry analysis and market intelligence
- AI economics and labor market impact
